turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: Average basket size, which the semantic layer defines as average order value (revenue over non-cancelled orders), was EUR 130.28 for the week of Monday 21 to Sunday 27 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
